key_points: No hard company news: headlines are analyst opinion pieces and 13F flow disclosures, which are largely noise
Recurring bull case centers on the NBCUniversal spin-off and a cheap ~4.4x EBITDA valuation for the remaining business
Broadband subscriber reset remains the key overhang; Simply Wall St/Trefis pieces flag the undervaluation debate rather than resolve it
Institutional selling (State Street, PSP, Carronade) is stale quarterly filing data, not a signal of new fundamental deterioration
Taylor Sheridan/NBCUniversal deal commentary is incremental content-cost color, not thesis-changing
